papers.title: Early-life ketone body signalling promotes beige fat biogenesis through changes in histone acetylome and β-hydroxybutyrylome
papers.summary_zh: 研究发现断奶前 Hmgcs2 依赖的酮体生成可促进米色脂肪形成并改善成年期代谢健康。Hmgcs2 缺失会阻碍米色脂肪生成，而增强酮体信号可提高能量消耗、线粒体生物发生与呼吸，并通过组蛋白乙酰化和 β-羟丁酰化激活产热基因。
papers.summary_en: Preweaning Hmgcs2-dependent ketogenesis promotes beige fat biogenesis and adult metabolic health. Hmgcs2 loss impairs beige adipogenesis, whereas enhanced ketone signaling increases energy expenditure and mitochondrial biogenesis through histone acetylation and β-hydroxybutyrylation.

papers.title: Role of LONP1 in human diseases: molecular mechanisms and therapeutic potential
papers.summary_zh: 该综述系统总结 LONP1 在蛋白质量控制、线粒体代谢、应激反应和多类人类疾病中的作用，为跨疾病寻找 LONP1 下游机制和干预策略提供框架。
papers.summary_en: This review summarizes LONP1 roles in mitochondrial protein quality control, metabolism, stress responses, and human diseases, offering a framework for identifying downstream mechanisms and interventions.

papers.title: Artemisinins ameliorate polycystic ovarian syndrome by mediating LONP1-CYP11A1 interaction
papers.summary_zh: 研究发现青蒿素类药物可直接靶向 LONP1，增强 LONP1 与 CYP11A1 的相互作用并促进 CYP11A1 降解，从而抑制卵巢雄激素过度合成；该作用在啮齿动物模型和 PCOS 患者中均显示改善潜力。
papers.summary_en: Artemisinins directly target LONP1, enhance its interaction with CYP11A1, and promote CYP11A1 degradation to suppress ovarian androgen overproduction. Benefits were demonstrated in rodent models and patients with PCOS.

papers.title: Unveiling the biological functions and therapeutic potentials of LONP1 in the ovary
papers.summary_zh: 该论坛文章总结 LONP1 在卵巢类固醇激素代谢、卵母细胞发育、生存与质量控制中的作用，并讨论其失调与 PCOS 和卵巢衰老的联系及治疗潜力。
papers.summary_en: This forum article reviews LONP1 functions in ovarian steroidogenesis, oocyte development, survival, and quality control, and discusses its dysregulation in PCOS and ovarian aging as a potential therapeutic target.

papers.title: Serum BMP8B levels in women with polycystic ovary syndrome: a case-control study
topics: 脂肪产热相关代谢调控
papers.summary_zh: 病例对照研究纳入 80 名 PCOS 女性与 40 名匹配对照，发现 PCOS 组血清 BMP8B 水平较低，并与胰岛素抵抗、脂质代谢和 BMI 等指标存在关联。该结果尚未经同行评议。
papers.summary_en: This case-control preprint compared 80 women with PCOS and 40 matched controls, reporting lower serum BMP8B in PCOS and associations with insulin resistance, lipid metabolism, and BMI. The findings have not yet been peer reviewed.

papers.title: Exercise attenuates polycystic ovary syndrome development via improved mitochondrial proteostasis
papers.journal: American Journal of Physiology-Endocrinology and Metabolism
papers.summary_zh: 研究在 DHEA 诱导的 PCOS 小鼠模型中发现，有氧运动可恢复卵巢 LONP1 表达与线粒体蛋白稳态，促进类固醇生成酶正常周转，并减轻高雄激素、炎症和纤维化。
papers.summary_en: In a DHEA-induced mouse model of PCOS, aerobic exercise restored ovarian LONP1 expression and mitochondrial proteostasis, normalized steroidogenic protein turnover, and reduced inflammation, fibrosis, and androgen excess.

papers.title: Single-cell transcriptomics uncovering a critical AKT-LONP1-STAR axis in ovarian hyperandrogenism of PCOS
papers.summary_zh: 单细胞转录组分析提示 PCOS 卵巢中 PI3K-AKT 信号降低会下调 LONP1，并导致 STAR 蛋白积累，从而推动卵巢膜细胞高雄激素生成，提出 AKT-LONP1-STAR 致病轴。
papers.summary_en: Single-cell analysis identifies an AKT-LONP1-STAR axis in PCOS: reduced PI3K-AKT signaling lowers LONP1, promotes STAR protein accumulation, and may drive excessive androgen production in ovarian theca cells.

papers.title: Bone morphogenetic protein 8B (BMP8B) increases the glucose sensitivity of ventromedial hypothalamus glucose-inhibited neurons in female mice
topics: 脂肪产热相关代谢调控
papers.summary_zh: 研究显示 BMP8B 可增强雌性小鼠腹内侧下丘脑葡萄糖抑制神经元的葡萄糖敏感性，并呈现性别差异，为 BMP8B 经中枢 AMPK 通路调节能量稳态提供补充证据。
papers.summary_en: BMP8B increased glucose sensitivity in ventromedial hypothalamic glucose-inhibited neurons in female mice, adding evidence for sex-specific central regulation of energy homeostasis through BMP8B and AMPK-related signaling.

papers.title: Modulation of Lonp1 Activity by Small Compounds
papers.summary_zh: 该综述总结了调控 LONP1 活性的小分子，并讨论 LONP1 激活剂恢复线粒体功能的潜力，其中包括其在 PCOS 等疾病中的潜在保护作用。
papers.summary_en: This review surveys small-molecule modulators of LONP1 and discusses the potential of LONP1 activators to restore mitochondrial function, including possible protective applications in PCOS.
